violation_type.title: Documentation pediatric CPR-1st aid includes renewal date and expiration date (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(1)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation pediatric CPR-1st aid includes renewal date and expiration date
violation_type.typical_finding: 3 out of 4 caregivers CPR/ First Aid certificates observed did not have an expiration or renewal date, trainers qualifications, and specified in pediatric training.

finding_variants.text: 3 out of 4 caregivers CPR/ First Aid certificates observed did not have an expiration or renewal date, trainers qualifications, and specified in pediatric training.
The director's certiface for training received on pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking and pediatric CPR did not include the expiration or renewal date of the training.
The infant caregiver did not have an official copy of the CPR and First Aid certificate showing the expiration date.
One out of ten employees have an expired CPR/First-aid card.
